'''2020 Endor Grand Prix''' was a Players Committee major event in Seattle, Washington, January 2020 (the only in-person major of that year). [[Hayes Hunter]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-endor-grand-prix/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Seattle, Washington
* '''Dates:''' January 2020
